intent.raw: invoke plan for the smallest human-workable ide-extension tool
intent.objective: Author an execution-ready, evidence-gated plan that repairs the L0 witness into a local Human Approval Desk without admitting L1 or external authority.
intent.operator_sentence: Plan the L0 Human Approval Desk, then hand one approved SWU at a time to Task Session.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The plan is bounded to one small local codebase and does not benefit from planning fan-out. Later Task Sessions may choose local execution per SWU.
receipt_requirements: Every SWU returns files touched, validation results, blockers, residue, and reroute.

steps.name: Build bounded planning context
stop_conditions: Accepted design or review evidence is missing or contradictory.

steps.name: Author layered implementation plan
stop_conditions: An execution task lacks a source anchor, write scope, done criteria, or validation surface.
The plan imports L1 or effectful authority into L0.

steps.name: Validate smallest coherent units and recomposition
convergence_criteria: One first SWU is executable without hidden product discovery.
All SWUs recompose into the approved L0 boundary.
stop_conditions: An acceptance-critical gap lacks an owner and repair path.

steps.name: Hand off one approved SWU

inputs.ref: explicit user approval and selected SWU ID

stop_conditions: The selected SWU gate is not ready.

gates.condition: Work-pack, layering, task/SWU contracts, waves, and validation strategy are complete and navigable.
Smallest unit, recomposition, hidden-gap, deferred-complexity, and navigation checks pass.
The operator explicitly selects one ready SWU before Task Session mutation.
No MCP, provider, browser-act, shell, Git, VSCodium, remote, or Nimbalyst authority enters the active L0 window.
Canonical Craft mutation occurs only through an explicit approved Craft operation after evidence exists.

boundaries.contract: Task Session receives one selected SWU by path and returns the required structured result.
Implementation evidence may propose a Craft delta but cannot mutate the canonical ledger without explicit Craft approval.

authority.evidence: ide-extension kernel for product receipts; Task Session for implementation receipts
authority.memory: Craft for project frontier; Invoke plan artifacts for execution planning
authority.promotion: human approval through the owning lifecycle

state_namespaces.owner: invoke plan until handoff; then target lifecycle
state_namespaces.write_policy: Planning artifacts only; no source implementation during Invoke.
No direct mutation from Invoke or implementation SWUs.

promotion_splits.rule: L0 completion does not promote any adapter; a separate approved plan and all promotion gates are required.

promotion_guardrails: No implementation begins without an explicit selected SWU.
No L1+ capability is admitted by completing L0.
No caller-selected identity becomes an approval claim.
No Craft frontier mutation occurs without Craft approval.
No plan success claim substitutes for implementation evidence.
